title.narrative: System Analysis PADEO approach Mozambique - Phase 1

description.narrative: The Dutch embassy in Maputo (EKN-Map) aims to apply programmatic and systems approach towards local private sector development (PSD) in Mozambique. This PADEO approach focuses on local needs, is inclusive, and aims to improve the productivity of small scale food producers’ (male and female) farming systems in order to increase their income and/or generate jobs; with a focus on creating income for youth and vulnerable people (YVP). The system that has been chosen to work for the PADEO approach in Mozambique is the small scale food producers’ farming system; complementing and supporting the overall outcome of the Food and Nutrition security program (F&NS) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs department Inclusive Good Growth, as described in the MACs 2023-2026.This assignment contributes to the setting up of the PADEO approach in Mozambique, one where systems thinking, programmatic approach and local needs is at the core. Two elements are crucial in this new approach: First, the alignment and the exchange of lessons learned with relevant stakeholders and existing (PSD and F&NS) programs in the country (Dutch or non-Dutch); second, the strong focus on local needs and representation. The approach should be a co-creation process whereby the consultant facilitates and actively engages relevant stakeholders, the PADEO team, and local actors.The project has a positive impact on:SDG 8: inclusive and sustainable economic growth;Target 8.3: Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovationSDG 2: Food security.

comment.narrative: Project PST24MZ01 operationalizes the findings of the PADEO system analysis study of the Sofala -Beira corridor (Project PST23MZ01). The project will result in a formulation report of an implementable 10-year strategy (a Theory of Change, a stakeholder engagement plan and Road map) with a 5-year implementable plan for the setting up of a TVET institution; which could contribute to changes in the selected system of the Sofala-Beira corridor; and in which the Netherlands can have a relevant added value.

title.narrative: Increased impact of an existing PSD project

comment.narrative:
• Project PST22MZ02: The focus of this study was on micro, small and medium enterprises (M)SMEs in the agro & food and horticulture sectors. The results of this project contribute to the analysis and systematization of the current situation of (M)SMEs and entrepreneurship by identifying key related constraints and barriers to start-up or scale-up their enterprises under a given value chain. This study has been the first stadium to apply for a PADEO program for the EKN-Map. The study has helped to collect the necessary information required to define a potential PADEO proposal (including methodology, potential partners, value chains, and relevant toolkits). This study is the starting point of project PST23MZ01 • This project (PST23MZ01) is part of the PADEO traject in Mozambique and consist in system analysis studies for two priority areas: Sofala and the Beira corridor; and Cabo Delgado. The results of PST22MZ02 are the starting point of this project
These projects are locally embedded and are the result of the work of the PADEO team Mozambique.
